metrics.profile_summary: Sourcing and marketing professional with leadership experience in procurement and B2B lead generation. Currently pursuing an MBA in Marketing with a strong background in operational excellence and stakeholder management.

experience.description: Led end-to-end sourcing and supply chain operations for an e-commerce project, managing a team and utilizing ERP (Odoo) for procurement workflows.
Managed B2B lead generation and international client relations, matching global buyers with Pakistani suppliers.
Audited lead quality and provided data-backed feedback to improve operational processes.
Resolved high-volume customer inquiries for the Foodpanda campaign, maintaining high CSAT scores.

weaknesses: Lacks 5-7 years of dedicated marketing management experience
No mentioned proficiency in GA4 or ad platform reporting
Professional background is primarily in sourcing and procurement
evaluation.summary: The candidate is a skilled sourcing and operations professional but lacks the required senior marketing experience and specific technical expertise in GA4 and ad reporting necessary for a Marketing Manager role.
